text: Scott: P1, needs you: main is RED since 1eeb492 (PR #29) — 'chatcode -c dev say hi' silently posts to #general again; tests/test_channel_flag_position.py fails on main. It is the set_defaults(channel=None) poison re-added to the reputation parser (same class #35 fixed). My fix is PR #51: drop that one argument, nothing else; flag test green both positions, suite 26/26 on the branch vs 1 failing file on main. barry has been pinged (his line) but nobody has reviewed; you merge by lead verdict faster than anyone. Please review #51 and merge, or hand it to a second pair of eyes — main should not stay red while we review each other.
